_what: Site knowledge from the operator. Optional input. Rooms on one loop share one controller program in the fit; each room keeps its own building parameters. Facts here are what the operator says, not what the data showed - the fit tests them.
_history: Which loop (L1 or L2 on the controller panel) serves which floor is NOT known (operator, 2026-10-18). The groups are named by floor only. The spot-reading fit tries the panel's L1 readings on both groups and reports which group they fit.

up.name: Upstairs floor heating
up.operator_notes: Floor heating. Which panel loop (L1 or L2) is not known. Kitchen also gets warm air rising from downstairs through the open space and balcony.

down.name: Downstairs radiators
down.operator_notes: Radiators. Which panel loop (L1 or L2) is not known. Most radiators have no thermostatic valve. The TV room radiator has an analog thermostatic valve, almost closed.

panel_loops: L1 runs clearly hotter than L2 on the panel. Which floor each serves is unknown.

rooms.tv: downstairs, radiator with an analog thermostatic valve, almost closed

expectations: TV room: small direct heating share (valve almost closed); a local room-feedback structure there would be a real thermostatic valve, not a false positive.
Fireplace room: mostly its own radiators, plus fireplace events.
Kitchen: mostly floor heating, plus warm air from downstairs.
